units.inputLength: L0 reference-length units; processing supplies epsilon=(L-Lbaseline)/Lbaseline
units.internalLengthCoordinate: u=Gamma*epsilon, powerstroke-normalized link coordinate; absolute origin needs its own declaration
units.codeGamma: Gamma=.5*s/h is dimensionless; reproduction script resets s=2.6e-6m,h=1e-8m ->Gamma130
units.physicalSerialScale: ell_gamma=2*Ns*dps=Lref/Gamma ONLY when Lref=Ns*s and h=dps
units.internalPE: kpe per internal u; K inverse internal u; kpe/K is the internal force prefactor
units.internalSE: kse0 is internal force prefactor; kse inverse internal u; tangent kse*(Fse+kse0)
units.outputForce: Fhat=Fscale*F_internal, dimensionless processed target. Physical Tref/area not identified.

PE.cutoffNote: Soft and linear branches have a small value/tangent mismatch at K*u=10; not globally identical to smooth softplus.

SE.domain: v<0 gives negative exponential force; other approximate path explicitly clamps inverse extension/force.

runtimeDiscretized.K: parms.K; historical measured MAT field K=100, not remeasured here
runtimeDiscretized.derivativeCaveat: For a differentiated softened CE force, sigmoid(KQ) belongs in both reaction derivative and held-population tangent; runtime uses raw terms.

reporting.transportOriginDifference: reported xi=xi0+L; runtime xi=xi0+(L-lce0); raw moment difference lce0*B when lce0!=0

oldComparisonPath.operation: scaled CE + Fpe_func output; function's own scaling must be verified before assigning its units

summaryExporter.operation: Loads raw fields including kpe,kse,kse0 and prints componentwise median; no Fscale/K conversion
summaryExporter.publicationAssociation: Not proven to generate final Table3. Final paper numbers cannot be assigned to transformed prefactors from this script alone.

conditionalDimensionalTransform.declarations: Tref physical force in N corresponding to the processed output normalizer; S=Fscale; C=Tref*S; ell_gamma physical metres per u
conditionalDimensionalTransform.outputNormalizedCoefficients: PE prefactor S*kpe/K, slope per u S*kpe; SE prefactor S*kse0, exponent per u kse
conditionalDimensionalTransform.sameElasticLawCoordinateChange: If u_new=a*u_old, use kpe_new=kpe_old/a, K_new=K_old/a, PEoffset_new=a*PEoffset_old, kse_new=kse_old/a, kse0_new=kse0_old, SEoffset_new=a*SEoffset_old, with fixed force scale.
conditionalDimensionalTransform.reproductionObservedUpdate: Script changes Gamma and rescales only kpe by Gamma_old/Gamma_new. This preserves the linear PE slope per relative input, not by itself the entire softplus or exponential law.
conditionalDimensionalTransform.scope: These identities select no physiological coefficients, lengths, head counts, force or area, and do not convert temperatures/rate families.

normalizationChain.gain: raw force/1000/fgain; gain metadata and explicit overrides in calc_force_pCa
normalizationChain.activationReference: Fi=mean(gain-corrected force over selected early interval); F0=median(Fi by pCa); Fmax=max(F0 by fiber)
normalizationChain.passiveSubtraction: No pCa9 subtraction in inspected operations; upstream tare/passive convention remains unresolved
normalizationChain.SIstatus: Sensor/raw-channel calibration and specimen area/configuration were not recovered. Rat22C source kinetics are not mixed with human/15C or temperature-adjusted.

publicationAmbiguity.equations: Parent re-inspected original Eq17-20 pixels: gamma_phys=2Ns*dps, PE prefactor times log(1+exp((L-L0)/gamma)), SE sigma*(exp(rho*(L-L0)/gamma)-1).
publicationAmbiguity.xps: No distinct x_ps definition recovered in inspected prose/pinned source. HTML inline images prevent exhaustive symbol interpretation. Do not equate Table xps^-1 with physical10nm.
publicationAmbiguity.alternatives: If xps labels a normalized coordinate, SI dimensional inconsistency need not follow; prefactor-vs-slope interpretation still needs K/width/output normalization. If it means a physical length, Eq19 requires a declared regularizing length factor to multiply a stiffness into a force prefactor.
publicationAmbiguity.notResolved: Article/code elastic-law numerical mapping, final Table3 exporter, specimen Tref/area, offsets/initial force balance and exact force transform.
